meta.note: Curated, version-scoped entries used for Known Vulnerability Correlation. Extend or swap for a CVE/NVD feed later (extension point).

entries.title: Development WSGI server exposed (Werkzeug)
entries.description: The Werkzeug development server appears to be serving the target. It is not hardened for production and has a public debugger risk.
entries.impact: Remote code execution via the interactive debugger if enabled; no production-grade hardening.
entries.remediation: Serve the app behind a production WSGI server (gunicorn/uwsgi) and never enable the debugger publicly.

entries.title: Outdated server version detected
entries.description: The detected server version falls in a range associated with known advisories.
entries.impact: Depends on the specific advisory; typically DoS or info disclosure.
entries.remediation: Update to the latest stable server release and keep an upgrade cadence.
